meta.name: content-strategist
meta.description: Analyze keyword data and propose high-impact content topics. Identifies keyword opportunities, analyzes SERP competition, and creates prioritized content roadmaps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析搜索词与竞争格局,产出优先内容选题与路线图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想要从搜索数据中找到读者真正需要的话题。
copy.tagline_en: Turn keyword data into a prioritized content roadmap
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan content and want data-backed topic ideas.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取网站搜索数据，用 Ahrefs 查关键词和搜索结果，评估竞争难度并打分，输出带优先级的“内容策略报告”，含话题、目标关键词和预估工作量。需先授权 Ahrefs。
howto.when: 当用户问“该写什么内容”、要关键词研究、找 SEO 机会等时触发；但需先完成 Ahrefs MCP 授权，否则会提示先运行 /mcp。

say.text: 我该写什么内容？先查一下我们最近的关键词数据并给建议。
say.note: Claude 会读取数据并产出内容建议。

say.text: 针对我们的核心产品找一些低难度关键词，整理成内容路线图。
say.note: 它会按难度给关键词评分并排优先级。

say.text: 分析这些关键词的搜索结果页，看哪些有排名机会。
say.note: 会对比 SERP 竞争情况，给出机会分析。

howto.what_en: Claude reads search performance data, runs Ahrefs keyword and SERP analysis, scores opportunities, and outputs a prioritized content roadmap with topics, target keywords, difficulty, and effort estimates. Requires Ahrefs MCP authorization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks what to write about, wants keyword research, or plans content topics. Ahrefs MCP must be authenticated.

say_en.text: What should I write about? Check our recent keyword data and suggest topics.
say_en.note: Claude will review the data and produce content ideas.

say_en.text: Find low-difficulty keywords for our product and make a content roadmap.
say_en.note: It will score and prioritize topics.

say_en.text: Check the SERP for these keywords to see where we can rank.
say_en.note: It will analyze competition and highlight gaps.
